ranks: The need-keys recheck list R2 (Phase 1 step 2)

authored.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

blocked.name: Multiclass Baldric
blocked.why: The keyword grants are writable, but 'as long as you have a full party, prevent all damage that would be dealt to equipped creature' has no replacement aimed at the Equipment's host.

blocked.name: Aerial Surveyor
blocked.why: 'If defending player controls more lands than you': opponent-controls-more asks any one opponent, exact only in two-player games.

blocked.name: Beza, the Bounding Spring
blocked.why: The lands and creatures comparisons are writable; 'an opponent has more life / more cards in hand than you' has no condition.

blocked.name: Cosmos Elixir
blocked.why: 'If your life total is greater than your starting life total': life-total takes fixed numbers or half-starting only.

blocked.name: Speaker of the Heavens
blocked.why: 'At least 7 life more than your starting life total': life-total takes fixed numbers only.

blocked.name: Ghirapur Orrery
blocked.why: The upkeep trigger's 'if that player has no cards in hand' — hand-size reads only you or each player.

blocked.name: Wakka, Devoted Guardian
blocked.why: Blitzball Captain's 'if a counter was put on Wakka this turn' — no per-object counters-put history.

blocked.name: Vampire Nocturnus
blocked.why: Revealing the top card is built; 'as long as the top card of your library is black' has no condition.

blocked.name: River of Tears
blocked.why: 'If you played a land this turn' — landsPlayedThisTurn is tracked but no condition reads it.

blocked.name: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron
blocked.why: Training Grounds' reduction with X = Agatha's power: reduceGeneric is a fixed number.

blocked.name: Biomancer's Familiar
blocked.why: The cost reduction is Training Grounds'; 'the next time target creature adapts this turn, it adapts as though it had no +1/+1 counters' has no adapt event to modify.

blocked.name: Bruenor Battlehammer
blocked.why: 'You may pay {0} rather than pay the equip cost of the first equip ability you activate each turn.'

blocked.name: Brutal Suppression
blocked.why: Activated abilities of nontoken Rebels cost an additional 'Sacrifice a land'.

blocked.name: Bureau Headmaster
blocked.why: 'Equip abilities you activate cost {1} less': abilityCostModification can't single out equip abilities.

blocked.name: Crown of Gondor
blocked.why: Equip's '{3} less if you're the monarch' — an ability's costReduction has no condition; and 'if there is no monarch'.

blocked.name: Hylda's Crown of Winter
blocked.why: 'This ability costs {1} less to activate during your turn' — an ability's costReduction has no condition.

blocked.name: Hulk, Gamma Goliath
blocked.why: 'Power-up abilities of other creatures you control cost {3} less.'

blocked.name: Professor Hojo
blocked.why: The first targeting activated ability each turn costs {2} less; the once-a-turn becomes-target trigger would also need an activated-only filter.

blocked.name: Tithe Taker
blocked.why: The tax reaches abilities opponents activate from any zone; abilityCostModification reaches permanents only.

blocked.name: Bladegraft Aspirant
blocked.why: 'Activated abilities of Equipment you control that target this creature cost {1} less.'

blocked.name: Mana Cache
blocked.why: Any player may remove a counter to add {C} — another player's mana ability isn't offered to pay their costs.

blocked.name: Tidal Control
blocked.why: 'Pay 2 life or {2}:' — an activated ability with a choice of costs.

blocked.name: Chainer, Nightmare Adept
blocked.why: 'You may cast a creature spell from your graveyard this turn' is one cast per activation (its ruling); the graveyard permission is never used up.

blocked.name: Kozilek, the Great Distortion
blocked.why: 'Discard a card with mana value X: Counter target spell with mana value X' — a discard cost whose filter reads X.

blocked.name: Titan's Presence
blocked.why: Reveal a colorless creature card as an additional cost, and read its power on resolution.

blocked.name: Belt of Giant Strength
blocked.why: Equip costs {X} less, X the targeted creature's power.

blocked.name: Warrior's Blades
blocked.why: Equip costs {1} less for each +1/+1 counter on the creature it targets.

blocked.name: Cemetery Prowler
blocked.why: Spells cost {1} less for each card type they share with cards exiled with it.

blocked.name: Charix, the Raging Isle
blocked.why: 'Spells your opponents cast that target Charix cost {2} more' — targetedBySpellsCost is life only.

blocked.name: Esior, Wardwing Familiar
blocked.why: Opponents' spells that target your commanders cost {3} more — no mana tax on spells by target.

blocked.name: Jubilant Skybonder
blocked.why: Grants fliers a {2} tax on opponents' spells that target them — life only, own permanent only.

blocked.name: Elspeth Conquers Death
blocked.why: Chapter II's tax until your next turn is no player-effect; chapter III's '+1/+1 counter or a loyalty counter' choice is unexpressed.

blocked.name: Killian, Ink Duelist
blocked.why: 'Spells you cast that target a creature cost {2} less' — costModification is matched before targets exist.

blocked.name: Spellwild Ouphe
blocked.why: 'Spells that target this creature cost {2} less' — any caster, read off the chosen targets.

blocked.name: Sage of the Beyond
blocked.why: 'Spells you cast from anywhere other than your hand cost {2} less' — castFrom names one zone.

blocked.name: Savvy Trader
blocked.why: The not-from-hand reduction; and the exiled permanent card may be *played* (a land too), where exile's mayCast casts only.

blocked.name: Thryx, the Sudden Storm
blocked.why: Mana value 5 or greater counts X on the stack (ruling); costModification reads it without X.

blocked.name: Trinisphere
blocked.why: A three-mana floor on every spell's total cost while untapped.

blocked.name: Soaring Stoneglider
blocked.why: 'Exile two cards from your graveyard or pay {1}{W}' — no exile-from-graveyard option branch.

blocked.name: Brainstealer Dragon
blocked.why: The impulse exile with any-colour spending is writable; 'they lose life' names the entering permanent's owner, which no player scope reads.

blocked.name: Crypt Rats
blocked.why: 'Spend only black mana on X' in an activated ability.

blocked.name: Elementalist's Palette
blocked.why: 'Spend this mana only on costs that contain {X}.'

blocked.name: Freya Crescent
blocked.why: 'Spend this mana only to cast an Equipment spell or activate an equip ability.'

blocked.name: Gonti, Lord of Luxury
blocked.why: Look at four, exile one face down, cast it while exiled with mana of any type — the exiled card's cast permission takes no spendAs.

blocked.name: Mm'menon, the Right Hand
blocked.why: Granted mana 'spend only to cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand'.

blocked.name: Sunglasses of Urza
blocked.why: 'You may spend white mana as though it were red mana.'

blocked.name: Throne of Eldraine
blocked.why: Mana only for monocolored spells of the chosen color, and 'spend only mana of the chosen color to activate this ability'.

blocked.name: Tinybones, the Pickpocket
blocked.why: 'You may cast target nonland permanent card from that player's graveyard, and mana of any type can be spent' — cast-now has no spendAs.

blocked.name: Mercurial Spelldancer
blocked.why: 'You may remove two oil counters from it. If you do, …' — may takes no counter-removal cost.

blocked.name: Geometric Nexus
blocked.why: 'Remove all charge counters' as a cost, with X the number removed.

blocked.name: Echoes of Eternity
blocked.why: Doubling reaches colorless spells' own triggers ('a colorless spell you control or another colorless permanent').

blocked.name: Twinning Staff
blocked.why: 'If you would copy a spell one or more times, instead copy it that many times plus an additional time.'

blocked.name: Borborygmos and Fblthp
blocked.why: 'You may discard any number of land cards' — anyNumber takes no filter.

blocked.name: Indominus Rex, Alpha
blocked.why: As it enters, discard any number of creature cards; it enters with a counter of each listed keyword among them.

blocked.name: Mishra's Command
blocked.why: Mode one's 'they may discard up to X cards' — X variable, the target player's choice.

blocked.name: Reinforcements
blocked.why: Up to three target cards put on top of the library in the order their owner chooses.

blocked.name: Scroll Rack
blocked.why: Exile any number from hand face down, take that many from the top, put the exiled cards back on top in any order.

blocked.name: Aetherspouts
blocked.why: For each attacking creature, its owner chooses top or bottom (APNAP), and orders their own cards going to the same end.

blocked.name: Clash of Elements
blocked.why: 'If they do, 2 damage' only if the card actually went to the top of the library.

blocked.name: Living Conundrum
blocked.why: The skip-draw replacement's order against Laboratory Maniac / Jace is the drawing player's (its ruling).

blocked.name: Phantom Centaur
blocked.why: Protection from black may prevent damage before its own prevention, losing no counter (its ruling); the engine always applies its replacement first.

blocked.name: Szadek, Lord of Secrets
blocked.why: The defending player may apply prevention before Szadek's replacement (its ruling).

blocked.name: Boseiju, Who Shelters All
blocked.why: Unrestricted {C} that makes an instant or sorcery it pays for uncounterable.

blocked.name: Firemind Vessel
blocked.why: 'Add two mana of different colors.'

blocked.name: Interplanar Beacon
blocked.why: 'Add two mana of different colors. Spend this mana only to cast planeswalker spells.'

blocked.name: Selvala, Heart of the Wilds
blocked.why: 'X mana in any combination of colors' activated by hand offers only all-of-one-colour past X = 4.

blocked.name: Squandered Resources
blocked.why: 'Add one mana of any type the sacrificed land could produce.'

blocked.name: Master Biomancer
blocked.why: Arwen's enters-with-counters replacement is there; 'and as a Mutant in addition to its other types' isn't.

blocked.name: Response // Resurgence
blocked.why: Resurgence's extra combat must add nothing when it resolves outside a main phase (ruling).

blocked.name: Hancock, Ghoulish Mayor
blocked.why: +X/+X where X is the number of counters of every kind on Hancock.

blocked.name: The Mouth of Sauron
blocked.why: Amass X, X the instant and sorcery cards in the target player's graveyard.

blocked.name: Command the Dreadhorde
blocked.why: Damage to you equal to the total mana value of an any-number target group.

blocked.name: Eris, Roar of the Storm
blocked.why: {2} less for each different mana value among instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.

blocked.name: Phyresis Outbreak
blocked.why: -1/-1 for each poison counter each creature's own controller has.

blocked.name: Shadow of Mortality
blocked.why: {X} less, X the difference between your starting life total and your life total.

blocked.name: Epic Experiment
blocked.why: Villainous Wealth's free casts from among the exiled cards are there; putting the uncast ones into the graveyard isn't.

blocked.name: Tersa Lightshatter
blocked.why: The ETB loot is Kinetic Augur's; the randomly exiled card may be *played* (a land too), where exile's mayCast and allow-cast-from-exile only cast.

blocked.name: Jin-Gitaxias // The Great Synthesis
blocked.why: Everything else on both faces is expressible; chapter I's 'no maximum hand size for as long as you control this Saga' is a one-shot effect, not the Saga's static.

blocked.name: Skirge Familiar
blocked.why: 'Discard a card: Add {B}' — the mana-ability activation resolves before a discard cost would be paid.

blocked.name: Molt Tender
blocked.why: The mill line is writable; '{T}, Exile a card from your graveyard: Add one mana of any color' is refused on a mana ability.
